svg.title: OfflineCV architecture at a glance
svg.desc: The OfflineCV pipeline drawn inside a dashed box labelled "your browser tab": drop a résumé file, read it with pdf.js, parse it in tiers, score it, edit it, export an ATS-safe PDF. Local storage and job matching also sit inside the box. Three dashed arrows leave the box — a keyword string, a pasted job-description URL, and a product-analytics event — and a footnote names what else leaves, including the on-device model download.

svg.text: Also leaving the tab: the on-device model download (1.6–2.3 GB) and the company job boards. The GitHub star count is third-party; the version check is same-origin. Any third-party call reveals your IP — full list in docs/architecture.md.
